title: Amazon Is Gutting Its AI Division After Sustained Failure
hook_text: Amazon is restructuring its AI division.
script:
Amazon is restructuring its AGI division after failing to lead.
The company struggled to ship a viable competitor to top models.
Their Nova model failed to gain traction against market leaders.
Engineers from the division are now moving to other internal teams.
Amazon prioritizes profit over burning cash on unproven AI research.
Competitors like Google and OpenAI currently dominate the model space.
Will this retreat help Amazon fix its AI product lineup?

editor.one_line: Too much generic filler and repetitive, low-quality stock imagery ruins the professional news tone.
script_fixes: LINE 1: Replace 'restructuring its AGI division' with 'slashing its AGI division headcount'.
LINE 2: Replace 'struggled to ship a viable competitor' with 'failed to gain market share with its Bedrock platform'.
LINE 5: Replace 'prioritizes profit over burning cash' with 'cuts costs to focus on core AWS cloud profitability'.
LINE 7: Replace 'fix its AI product lineup' with 'salvage its enterprise AI strategy'.
visual_notes: line 1: Generic building photo is uninformative; use a chart or internal memo screenshot.
line 4: Stock footage of a person typing is generic and adds no value.
line 5: Stock footage of a hand drawing a chart is a cliché and visually misleading.
line 7: Dark, low-contrast stock footage makes the final frame unreadable.
